name: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
provider: Ministry of MSME, Govt of India
short_description: Credit-linked subsidy program to generate employment opportunities by setting up micro-enterprises in non-farm sectors.
detailed_benefits: Margin money subsidy of 25% (general urban) up to 35% (special category / rural) on bank-financed projects up to ₹50 Lakhs for manufacturing and ₹20 Lakhs for service units.
verifier: Sahay Scheme Verification Team / KVIC MSME Portal

documents.title: Permanent Account Number (PAN)
documents.description: PAN card of the individual proprietor or enterprise.

documents.title: Detailed Project Appraisal Report (DPR)
documents.description: Project report showing cost of machinery, civil works, and working capital.

rules.explanation: Business sector must be in non-farm manufacturing, services, or agro-processing.
Applicant enterprise must fall within micro-enterprise capital limits.
Active commercial bank account required for credit disbursement.
Women entrepreneurs qualify for higher 35% margin money subsidy.
Udyam registration accelerates bank appraisal and subsidy verification.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (Tarun)
short_description: Collateral-free institutional loans for established micro-enterprises looking to expand operations.
detailed_benefits: Zero collateral business loans from ₹5 Lakhs up to ₹10 Lakhs disbursed through commercial banks, RRBs, and MFIs at standard competitive interest rates.
verifier: Sahay Scheme Verification Team / MUDRA Official Portal

documents.title: Last 6 Months Bank Statement
documents.description: Continuous commercial or savings bank statement verifying cash receipts.

documents.title: Proprietor PAN Card
documents.description: PAN card for identity and credit bureau verification.

rules.explanation: Must be a micro or small non-corporate enterprise.
Must possess active operative bank account.
Udyam MSME number verifies formal status with lending institutions.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (Shishu & Kishore)
short_description: Initial stage microcredit and working capital loans up to ₹5 Lakhs for nascent and growing small businesses.
detailed_benefits: Shishu covers loans up to ₹50,000 for startup micro-units; Kishore covers loans from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 for acquiring equipment and initial inventory with no collateral requirement.
verifier: Sahay Scheme Verification Team / MUDRA Official Portal

documents.title: Machinery or Stock Quotation
documents.description: Vendor quotation for equipment or initial stock being purchased.

rules.explanation: Applicant must possess an active operative bank account.
Non-corporate micro-business operating in revenue-generating sector.
Udyam registration prioritizes processing under priority sector lending.

name: Banglashree Scheme (West Bengal State MSME)
provider: Department of MSME&T, Govt of West Bengal
short_description: State capital investment subsidy and electricity duty reimbursement for micro-enterprises located in West Bengal.
detailed_benefits: 15% to 25% state capital investment subsidy on plant & machinery, plus 5-year waiver on electricity duty and interest subsidy for micro units.
verifier: Sahay Scheme Verification Team / West Bengal MSME&T Department

documents.title: Municipal Trade License
documents.description: Valid municipal trade license or panchayat certificate for operation in West Bengal.

documents.title: Udyam Registration Certificate
documents.description: MSME Udyam registration acknowledging location within West Bengal district.

rules.explanation: State-specific incentive available exclusively for units operating in West Bengal.
Applies to manufacturing and eligible servicing units.
Udyam registration required for single-window state clearance.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
provider: Department of Financial Services, MoF & SIDBI
short_description: Promotes entrepreneurship among women and SC/ST communities for setting up greenfield enterprises.
detailed_benefits: Composite loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading.
verifier: Sahay Scheme Verification Team / SIDBI Standup Mitra Portal

documents.title: Category Certificate (SC/ST) or Gender Verification
documents.description: Proof of SC/ST caste category, or identity document confirming woman entrepreneur.

documents.title: Greenfield Project Proposal
documents.description: Business proposal establishing the enterprise is a first-time venture (greenfield).

documents.title: PAN & KYC Records
documents.description: Standard business and promoter KYC identification.

rules.explanation: Operative bank account required for institutional loan processing.
Targeted at women entrepreneurs for affirmative bank branch sanctions.
Udyam registration facilitates institutional verification.

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
short_description: Enables credit flow to micro and small enterprises by providing loan guarantee coverage without third-party collateral.
detailed_benefits: Credit guarantee coverage up to 85% for micro-enterprises and women-owned units on credit facilities up to ₹500 Lakhs, removing the necessity for collateral security.
verifier: Sahay Scheme Verification Team / CGTMSE Official Portal

documents.title: Udyam Registration Certificate
documents.description: Valid MSME Udyam registration certificate confirming enterprise status.

rules.explanation: Enterprise must possess valid MSME Udyam Registration for CGTMSE coverage.
Eligible for new and existing micro and small manufacturing and service units.
Women-owned micro-enterprises receive higher guarantee coverage (85%).

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
provider: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
short_description: Special microcredit facility offering working capital loans to urban street vendors and micro nano-enterprises.
detailed_benefits: Collateral-free working capital loans of ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment and cashback on digital transactions.
verifier: Sahay Scheme Verification Team / MoHUA PM SVANidhi Portal

documents.title: Aadhaar Linked Mobile Number
documents.description: Aadhaar verification for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) and credit assessment.

documents.title: Vending Certificate / Urban Local Body Recommendation
documents.description: Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from Municipal Authority.

rules.explanation: Bank account required for digital disbursement and interest subsidy credit.
Must be engaged in retail vending, goods distribution, or personal services.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
provider: Ministry of MSME, Govt of India
short_description: Holistic support scheme providing recognition, skill training, toolkits, and subsidized collateral-free loans for traditional artisans and craftspeople.
detailed_benefits: Recognition as Vishwakarma through certificate and ID, ₹15,000 modern toolkit incentive, and collateral-free credit up to ₹3 Lakhs at concessional 5% interest rate.
verifier: Sahay Scheme Verification Team / PM Vishwakarma National Portal

documents.title: Aadhaar Card & Bank Account Details
documents.description: Aadhaar and linked bank passbook for direct toolkit incentive and loan credit.

documents.title: Traditional Trade Self-Declaration
documents.description: Self-declaration of practicing one of the 18 traditional family trades.

rules.explanation: Active bank account required for DBT toolkit disbursement.
Eligible for traditional artisans working with hands and tools.
